issues.before: Lire le récit ne permet pas de faire semblant de savoir démontrer.
issues.after: Inutile de faire comme si lire ce récit suffisait à savoir mener la démonstration.
issues.source_issue: The Chinese says readers need not pretend reading the story equals being able to derive the result. Current ne permet pas de faire semblant oddly says the story does not permit pretense; restore the non-equivalence without reproaching or excluding ordinary readers.

issues.before: Et pourtant, les deux peuvent correspondre.
issues.after: Et voilà que les deux valeurs correspondent.
issues.source_issue: The ending points to this actual historical meeting of the values, not merely their general possible agreement. Preserve the already-established discovery and the sense of surprise without adding precision.

issues.before: Matériau et contexte doivent être jugés ensemble.
issues.after: La datation doit tenir compte à la fois du matériau et du contexte.
issues.source_issue: The date is what must be judged from material and context together. Current wording turns material and context into the objects being judged, rather than grounds for dating. The explicit natural subject preserves the scientific boundary.

issues.before: Lui non plus n'a pas raconté d'avance tout ce qui arriverait ensuite à l'arbre.
issues.after: Lui non plus ne dit pas tout de la suite de la vie de l'arbre.
issues.source_issue: The narrow ring does not exhaust the subsequent life of the whole tree. Added d’avance restricts the point to prediction; the Chinese is about not saying everything after that year, whether already happened or still open. Preserve descriptive incompleteness rather than introduce foretelling.
